title: RuneScape Holds a Guinness World Record for 1,198 Original Songs
hook: Guinness counted 1,198 original pieces of music in RuneScape in 2017, more than any other video game, and nearly 255 million accounts on top of that. Which RuneScape track lives rent free in your head?
script: Did you know RuneScape holds a Guinness World Record for having more original music than any other video game? In July of 2017, Guinness counted one thousand one hundred ninety eight original pieces of music written for RuneScape. Jagex composed all of it in house, with new tracks arriving alongside new quests and new areas. That was one of three records the game picked up that summer. Guinness also named RuneScape the most prolifically updated MMORPG. It counted more than a thousand updates since the game launched in January of 2001, which works out to roughly one every week. The third record was for players. By July of 2017, almost two hundred fifty five million accounts had been created, more than any other MMO that publishes its numbers. The records actually go back further than that. In 2008, Jagex picked up a Guinness certificate for the most popular free MMORPG in the world. Old School RuneScape has its own entry too. Guinness lists it as the first MMO ever to release an old school version, back in February of 2013. Today more than three hundred million accounts have been created across the franchise.
